## Goal
Make the Mission Control Nerve Center (MCNC) interface professional, sleek, and totally functional while strictly adhering to the Rhythm Visual Line Standard (true Goldenrod #DAA520 for structural lines only, obsidian glass backgrounds, silver/white-smoke text).

## Constraints & Preferences
- Use Goldenrod (#DAA520) ONLY for structural lines/borders (never backgrounds or text)
- Use Obsidian glass backgrounds: #070913 (base), #0f172a (panel), #131b2e (card)
- Use Silver/white-smoke text: #f8fafc (main), #94a3b8 (muted)
- Maintain hard two-column layout concept (chat/command stream | telemetry/agent status)
- Preserve all original functionality: tabs 00-10, Monty 2 chat, file attachment, audio summary, log export
- No unauthorized colors (no DodgerBlue, no OrangeRed)
- Interface must be responsive
